items.headline: Dubai equities erase geopolitical losses
items.summary: Financial and real estate shares drove a recovery that completely wiped out earlier market declines.
items.why: It shows strong investor confidence in Dubai property and financial sectors.
items.impact_reason: Boosts investor sentiment and property market liquidity.

items.headline: Dubai airport expansion contracts reach $21.8bn
items.summary: Aviation sector growth accelerates as major airport development contracts hit a massive milestone.
items.why: Infrastructure growth of this scale directly drives real estate demand and economic expansion.
items.impact_reason: Enhances long-term regional connectivity and property appeal.

items.headline: Aldar achieves $245m in Yas Island sales
items.summary: Strong international and expatriate demand propelled recent property transactions for the developer in Abu Dhabi.
items.why: It highlights robust foreign investment trends within the UAE property market.
items.impact_reason: Reflects strong buyer demand and developer sales performance.

items.headline: Etihad Rail opens two Al Dhafra stations
items.summary: New passenger stations in Liwa and Madinat Zayed expand the national network ahead of a cultural festival.
items.why: Transport infrastructure improvements can enhance regional accessibility and long-term development value.
items.impact_reason: Improves regional transport connectivity and accessibility.

items.headline: Etihad Rail connects Abu Dhabi desert towns
items.summary: Madinat Zayed and Liwa stations officially join the passenger network to ease winter travel.
items.why: Expanded rail connectivity links remote areas to the wider emirate, supporting future growth.
items.impact_reason: Expands national rail network access to regional towns.

items.headline: Global oil benchmarks and UAE petrol prices
items.summary: Global oil prices decline as the UAE prepares to announce upcoming fuel rate adjustments.
items.why: This is a general macroeconomic news piece without direct impact on property or mortgages.
items.impact_reason: No direct impact on real estate or mortgages.

items.headline: Traffic congestion concerns for Dubai buyers
items.summary: Rapid development in areas like Arjan raises questions about road infrastructure capacity.
items.why: An opinion piece and reader query lacking hard news value.
items.impact_reason: Opinion piece containing no actionable news.

items.headline: Dubai stocks record strong monthly gains
items.summary: Equities surge on government incentives, corporate earnings, and foreign investment inflows.
items.why: Broader stock market performance is not directly tied to real estate transactions.
items.impact_reason: Focuses on general equity markets rather than property.

items.headline: Dubai housing authority introduces smart property passports
items.summary: A new digital passport system has been launched to consolidate residential data in Dubai. This initiative aims to streamline information access for the housing sector.
items.why: It improves transparency and data organization across the local property market.
items.impact_reason: Enhances data management without altering market fundamentals.

items.headline: Binghatti takes Dubai real estate to Lagos
items.summary: Binghatti Developer is hosting an exhibition to present its Dubai portfolio to investors in Lagos. The event targets international buyers interested in the local market.
items.why: It highlights international marketing efforts targeting overseas capital for Dubai real estate.
items.impact_reason: Marketing event with minimal immediate impact on domestic supply.

items.headline: Aldar launches NOMA creative district in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Aldar has introduced an expansive creative neighbourhood spanning 88,000 square metres within Saadiyat Cultural District. The project expands the cultural and residential footprint in the capital.
items.why: It increases the regional supply of mixed-use real estate developments.
items.impact_reason: Large-scale project launch expands regional cultural and residential supply.

bullets: On Thursday 26 November, Dubai recorded 466 sales worth AED 1.4bn, which is 3.5% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 55.4% of the day's sales, compared to 58.3% over the last seven days.
The median price was AED 1,667 per sq ft, down 1.5% over 30 days and 0.7% from last year.
Over the last seven days, the busiest areas were JVC with 225 sales, Business Bay with 137, and Dubai South with 132.
In October new rental contracts for a 1-bedroom apartment in JVC had a median of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Dubai equities have erased geopolitical losses, showing strong investor confidence in our property and financial sectors.
Market discussions are actively addressing potential property correction risks and the regional growth outlook.
Dubai airport expansion contracts have now reached $21.8bn, driving real estate demand through infrastructure growth.
